title: Gender-Neutral Machine Translation Strategies in Practice

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation (MT) systems by translating English templated sentences with determined versus ambiguous gender referents (using pronouns like 'I', 'you', or singular 'they') into grammatical gender languages (Icelandic, Czech, and Spanish). The methodology measures the proportions of masculine, feminine, and gender-neutral adjective translations to quantify the 'default masculine response' and 'gender-neutral response', as well as testing the impact of binary gender stereotypes (using stereotyped occupations and adverbs) on translation choices.
